name: marco-vrinssen
description: Claude Code plugins by Marco Vrinssen.

plugins.name: text-optimizer
plugins.description: Flag-driven text transforms. Load with /text, then start a message with a flag to correct, translate, sharpen, polish, soften, shorten or list text, or to build prompts for Claude and image models.

plugins.name: mdr-check
plugins.description: Checks health and wellness marketing copy for wording that could make the product a medical device or an illegal medical claim under EU MDR 2017/745, HWG and UWG. Returns each flagged phrase with its legal hook, a risk tier and a safer rewrite.

plugins.name: video-reader
plugins.description: Reads YouTube videos through their transcript, chapters and metadata with yt-dlp, and samples still frames for on-screen content. Summarizes, answers questions and cites timestamps.
